data.exact_reserve_text:
Included within the claims outstanding at 31 December 2014 is an Unexpired Risk Reserve of GBP 2.1m (31 December 2013: GBP 0.3m). A favourable/(adverse) run-off deviation was experienced during the year in respect of the following classes of business:

The 2013 year of account suffered a deterioration of GBP 2.1m in respect of two large incurred claims during the year and a generally higher than expected increase in attritional claims.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Deterioration of GBP 2.1m in respect of two large incurred claims during the year and a generally higher than expected increase in attritional claims.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 85.354m. The syndicate reports mixed run-off in 2014 with class-level favourable and adverse movements: a favourable run-off on third party motor offset by adverse development in other motor classes and a small adverse impact on reinsurance-inwards, producing mixed reserve movements overall. The 2013 year of account experienced deterioration of GBP 2.1m due to two large incurred claims and higher than expected attritional claims. No single large named catastrophe is cited.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities: Claims outstanding, prior-year comparative). No explicit single gross prior-year development (movement in prior years) figure or a gross 'Movement in prior year's provision' table was located in the provided extracts; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. A class-level favourable/(adverse) run-off deviation table is present and was used to populate lob movements. The Profit & Loss 'change in provision for claims (gross)' figure (8.989m) represents the total change in gross provision (current year movements included) and is not the same as prior-year development and was not used for prior_year_development_gbp_m.
